import statsmodels.api as sm

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t')

# Remove the 'habitat' column
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.drop(columns=['habitat'])

# Calculate the proportion of gardening-introduced non-native plants
invaded_niche['proportion_gardening'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Define the independent variables and the dependent variable
X = invaded_niche[['cropland.1956.50m', 'urban.1956.50m', 'elevation', 'annual.rainfall']]
y = invaded_niche['proportion_gardening']

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the multiple regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Print the summary of the model
model.summary()
